title: Direct Deposit Measure Used in Pocketwire Personal Account Instant Fee Rates
content:
**Definition.** The direct deposit measure of the instant fee rate on a Pocketwire Personal Account depends on the account's age in calendar days from its opened date:

- for an account at least 365 days old it is the middle value of the last three monthly totals (the last month, the month before it and the month before that, so that one unusual month neither lifts nor sinks it);
- for an account at least 180 but under 365 days old it is the lower of the last two monthly totals;
- for a younger account it is the total of the direct deposits dated in the last month.

The monthly total N months back is the deposits dated inside the window of N months less those dated inside the window of N less one months; a deposit counts inside a window of N months when it is dated later than the same calendar day N months before the handling date. The account's age is the number of calendar days from the opened date to the handling date.

| Account age (calendar days) | Direct deposit measure |
|---|---|
| 365 or more | Middle value of the last three monthly totals |
| 180 to 364 | Lower of the last two monthly totals |
| Up to 179 | Total of the last month |

### Worked measures (hypothetical, handling date 20 August)

The last month is the dates after 20 July; the month before it runs from 21 June to 20 July; the month before that from 21 May to 20 June.

| Monthly totals (last, before, before that) | Age 400 days | Age 200 days | Age 100 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2600.00, 1800.00, 900.00 | 1800.00 | 1800.00 | 2600.00 |
| 400.00, 2200.00, 2100.00 | 2100.00 | 400.00 | 400.00 |
| 1500.00, 1500.00, 0.00 | 1500.00 | 1500.00 | 1500.00 |
